title: Macaroni Pasta Bake
description: A classic comfort food dish made with macaroni pasta, a blend of cheeses, and a hint of spice.
instructions: Cook the macaroni according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large saucepan, combine the oozey cheese, zanzibari spice blend, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Heat over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the cheese is melted and smooth.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked macaroni, cheese mixture, and a splash of milk (optional). Mix well to combine.
Transfer the macaroni mixture to a baking dish and top with additional oozey cheese (if using).
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the macaroni is heated through.
Optional: Add some pasta to the top of the macaroni bake for a fun twist.
